ability_en: [CONTINUOUS] All of your Minions get +200 BP.

ability_zh: 【自己的回合】自己的无色 Mana 在支付 Field Minion 费用时视为所有颜色。
ability_en: [YOUR TURN] Your colorless Mana counts as every color when paying the cost of a Field Minion.

ability_zh: 【常时】对手 Minion 对自己玩家造成的伤害 -1。
ability_en: [CONTINUOUS] Damage dealt to you by opposing Minions is reduced by 1.

ability_zh: 【常时】自己的所有费用 5 以上 Minion DP+1。
ability_en: [CONTINUOUS] All of your Minions with cost 5 or more get +1 DP.

ability_zh: 【对手的回合】自己的费用 5 以下 Minion 不会被对手 Minion 的效果选择。
ability_en: [OPPONENT'S TURN] Your Minions with cost 5 or less cannot be selected by opposing Minion effects.

ability_zh: 【常时】自己手牌中 Magic 卡的无色费用 -2。
ability_en: [CONTINUOUS] Magic cards in your hand cost 2 less colorless Mana.

ability_zh: 【自己的回合】每当自己的 Minion Mana 移动到 Field 时，将 1 个无色 Mana 以疲劳状态放置到 Base。
ability_en: [YOUR TURN] Whenever one of your Minion Mana moves to the Field, place one rested colorless Mana in your Base.

ability_zh: 【自己的回合开始时】若自己的 Mana 为 4 个以上，本回合移动权 +1。
ability_en: [START OF YOUR TURN] If you have 4 or more Mana, gain 1 additional movement for this turn.

ability_zh: 【自己的回合结束时】将自己的所有 Mana 变为激活状态。
ability_en: [END OF YOUR TURN] Activate all of your Mana.

ability_zh: 【自己的回合结束时】将自己的所有非 Token Minion 变为激活状态。
ability_en: [END OF YOUR TURN] Activate all of your non-token Minions.
